title: Follow song tempo in sequence auditions
changes: Estimate song timing from decoded tempo commands across all tracks, including when one track is selected, with manual-rate fallback and explicit zero-tempo and bounded-scan behavior.
Schedule note starts, ends and PCM envelopes on the resulting time map and align the note canvas and playhead on elapsed seconds.
validation: Synthetic units rom-data-viewer-sequence-tempo-synthetic-0bksevth and rom-data-viewer-sequence-tempo-timeline-lfnlvmos passed cross-track tempo changes, simultaneous ordering, zero tempo, manual fallback, audio controls and timeline alignment.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-sequence-tempo-eur-5k5nafnt counted 1150 tempo instructions and checked one cross-track note in automatic and manual modes using live Chrome Web Audio.
Offline Docker/Python output parity passed in rom-data-viewer-sequence-tempo-docker-cxqeosrd; the validated ignored local viewer was published with the paused JSON inspector excluded.
limitations: The tempo calculation is a continuous estimate from a generic M4A reference; exact FFTA timing, live tempo multipliers and frame quantization are unverified, and bounded scans can be incomplete.
Other audio effects, full mixer fidelity and physical audio remain unverified; Windows was not tested.
